body:
Rhyme Time: 1. mat (also sat) 2. tree 3. any rhyme with dog, such as log, frog, hog, jog. 4. red, green.
Read It Smoothly: score the third reading. Got it! means few or no errors, phrases read as phrases, and a voice that sounds like talking.
My Rhyme Picture: any rhyming pair, such as cat and hat, bee and tree, sun and bun.
Poem Reading Check: 1. Score accuracy and smoothness on the whole poem. 2. pat and stop (the words that rhyme with hat and drop). 3. pit, pat, drip, drop.
Scoring tip: fluency is not speed. A careful, smooth reading with one self-correction is still Got it! on "I read smoothly".
title: Answer key: Rhymes and Smooth Reading
